source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 11 noiembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Teodor Studitul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Θεόδωρος ο Ομολογητής ηγούμενος Μονής Στουδίου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: born at Constantinople in 759, abbot of Sakkoudion and then of the Studios, three times exiled, dead in exile in 826. Its head line «(759 - 826)» supplies the years the folder did not hold. Its first apolytikion, which names him, is taken here; the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» in Ἦχος πλ. δ’ and the other hymn sections are not drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Îndreptătorule al Ortodoxiei, învăţătorule al dreptei cinstiri de Dumnezeu şi al curăţiei şi luminătorule al lumii, podoaba călugărilor cea de Dumnezeu insuflată Sfinte Părinte Teodor, înţelepte, cu învăţăturile tale pe toţi i-ai luminat. Alăută duhovnicească, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Teodor Studitul

english.text: Guide of Orthodoxy, teacher of the right worship of God and of purity, light of the world, God-inspired adornment of monks, wise father Theodore: by thy teachings thou hast enlightened all. O spiritual harp, pray to Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Δώρων μέτοχος, τῆς ἀφθαρσίας, δῶρον ἄσυλον, τῆς Ἐκκλησίας, φερωνύμως ἀνεδείχθης Θεόδωρε, τοὶς ἱεροὶς γὰρ ἑπόμενος δόγμασιν, ὁμολογίας φωστὴρ ἐχρημάτισας. Πάτερ Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν Ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιος Θεόδωρος ο Ομολογητής ηγούμενος Μονής Στουδίου», and it names him and plays on his name as a gift.

english.text: A sharer in the gifts of incorruption, you were shown forth, true to your name, as an inviolable gift of the Church, Theodore; for following the sacred doctrines you became a beacon of confession. Venerable father, entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Θεόδωρος γεννήθηκε στην Κωνσταντινούπολη το 759 μ.Χ.», with the page's own head «(759 - 826)».

death.note: saint.gr: «Πέθανε στην εξορία το 826 μ.Χ. σε ηλικία 67 ετών, στη χερσόνησο του Ακρίτα του Αγίου Τρύφωνα».
